items.text: Single-window mode for Windows is planned and split into eight tasks.
The viewer's browser processes already exit on their own when the last viewer closes; a test now holds that.
A viewer left in a background tab or minimized window now sheds memory at once and sleeps after 30 seconds.
Viewers restored into a background tab wait until they are shown before loading their page.
Tabs that share a name list in the order they opened in the Windows sidebar, so dragging a tab or opening another no longer makes the selection hop.
Opening a window on another machine no longer freezes Ghoztty while it connects.
The performance baseline now opens markdown, git-status and website viewers and measures what they cost.
Agent-held panes did not get slower with T3019: the relay-throughput red was measurement noise, and the guard is green again.
